missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Предприятие' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Крупное' and 'промышленное' are agreeing neuter adjectives describing the firm.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Предприятие' is the accusative direct object of 'построило'. Neuter nouns keep the same form in the accusative as the nominative. 'Новое' agrees in neuter.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Предприятия' takes the genitive to show whose workers they are. 'Этого' agrees in the neuter genitive, ending in -ого.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Предприятию' takes the dative as the thing helped by 'помогает'. The neuter dative singular ends in -ю. 'Молодому' agrees in the neuter dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Предприятием' takes the instrumental because 'руководить' governs that case. The neuter instrumental singular ends in -ем. 'Большим' agrees.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Предприятии' takes the prepositional after 'на' to show the workplace. The neuter ending in -ии marks the prepositional singular.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. 'Предприятия' follows 'два', which requires the genitive singular of neuter nouns. The verb 'закрыли' takes the count as its object.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Предприятий' takes the genitive plural after 'много'. Neuter nouns in -ие form this plural in -ий. 'Новых' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Предприятия' is the nominative plural subject of 'выпускают'. Neuter nouns form the plural in -я here. 'Эти' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Предприятия' takes the genitive after 'без' to express absence. The neuter genitive singular ends in -я here.
